note: Approximate training cutoffs, keyed by model family. Edit freely, add your own. These are a prior, not evidence: vendors are vague, post-training on recent data blurs the line, and models are frequently wrong about their own cutoff in both directions. The probe is the evidence. This file only decides whether a run gets flagged as high risk before scoring starts.
matching: A model name is reduced to its family by dropping any registry prefix and the :tag, then matched exactly, then by longest key prefix. So 'library/llama3.2:3b-instruct-q4_0' matches 'llama3.2'.
